name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_first_charge_path_20260803_152500_219422
sql:
/* 三组五日首充路径：首充商品名称、距创角分钟、首充前最后主线关卡、是否正处于入门10-10-1~10-10-5。 */
WITH Cfg AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' ts,DATE '2026-08-02' te,DATE '2026-05-08' ss),
TB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)' grp,c.u FROM SC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.u FROM SC c JOIN SA a ON c.u=a.u),
PayRaw AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,e."#user_id" uid,e."#event_time" pt,e."$part_date" pd,
        CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR) sku,
        COALESCE(dp."product_id@product_name_tc",CONCAT('未映射商品(',CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR),')')) product_name,
        TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE)/COALESCE(x.exchange,1) amount
 FROM ta.v_event_18 e
 LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
 LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x ON e."$part_date"=x.ex_date AND e.pay_currency=x.currency
 LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52801 dp ON TRY_CAST(e.product_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
 CROSS JOIN Cfg c
 WHERE e."$part_event"='charge' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.te AS VARCHAR)
   AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111') AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",e."#user_id",e."#event_time",e."$part_date",CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR),
        COALESCE(dp18."product_id@product_name_tc",dp13."product_id@product_name_tc",CONCAT('未映射商品(',CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR),')')),
        TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)
 FROM ta.v_event_13 e JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
 LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52801 dp18 ON TRY_CAST(e.product_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(dp18."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
 LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_13_0_20639 dp13 ON TRY_CAST(e.product_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(dp13."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
 CROSS JOIN Cfg c
 WHERE e."$part_event"='charge' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,c.te),c.ss) AS VARCHAR)
   AND b.u IS NULL AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE)
),
FirstPay AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY grp,aid ORDER BY pt) rn FROM PayRaw) WHERE rn=1),
Role AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,MIN(e."#event_time") rt FROM ta.v_event_18 e LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111') GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",MIN(e."#event_time") FROM ta.v_event_13 e JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2
),
StageBeforeRaw AS (
 SELECT p.grp,p.aid,TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT) stage_id,e."#event_time" stage_time FROM FirstPay p JOIN ta.v_event_18 e ON p.grp='繁体CBT' AND p.aid=e."#account_id" AND e."#event_time"<=p.pt WHERE e."#event_name"='stage_fight' AND TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER)=1001
 UNION ALL SELECT p.grp,p.aid,TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT),e."#event_time" FROM FirstPay p JOIN ta.v_event_13 e ON p.grp<>'繁体CBT' AND p.aid=e."#account_id" AND e."#event_time"<=p.pt WHERE e."#event_name"='stage_fight' AND TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER)=1001
),
StageBefore AS (
 SELECT grp,aid,stage_id FROM (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY grp,aid ORDER BY stage_time DESC) rn FROM StageBeforeRaw) WHERE rn=1
),
StageName AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT) id,MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") name,MAX("stage_id@stage_name_real") real_name FROM ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765 GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT),MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show"),MAX("stage_id@stage_name_real") FROM ta_dim.dim_13_0_18203 GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)',TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT),MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show"),MAX("stage_id@stage_name_real") FROM ta_dim.dim_13_0_18203 GROUP BY 1,2
),
Detail AS (
 SELECT p.*,DATE_DIFF('minute',CAST(r.rt AS TIMESTAMP),CAST(p.pt AS TIMESTAMP)) mins,s.stage_id,
        COALESCE(n.name,'创角后尚未挑战主线') stage_name,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(n.name,'') = '入门:10-10' THEN '首充时正处于10-10-1~5' ELSE '首充时不在10-10-1~5' END ten_ten,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(n.name,'') = '入门:10-10' THEN CONCAT('入门:10-10-', SUBSTR(CAST(s.stage_id AS VARCHAR),-1)) ELSE '非10-10' END ten_ten_stage
 FROM FirstPay p LEFT JOIN Role r ON p.grp=r.grp AND p.aid=r.aid
 LEFT JOIN StageBefore s ON p.grp=s.grp AND p.aid=s.aid
 LEFT JOIN StageName n ON p.grp=n.grp AND s.stage_id=n.id
),
Agg AS (
 SELECT 'first_product' module,grp,product_name dimension,COUNT(*) users,SUM(amount) revenue FROM Detail GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT 'first_time',grp,CASE WHEN mins<=10 THEN '01.0-10分钟' WHEN mins<=30 THEN '02.10-30分钟' WHEN mins<=60 THEN '03.30-60分钟' WHEN mins<=120 THEN '04.60-120分钟' WHEN mins<=240 THEN '05.120-240分钟' ELSE '06.240分钟以上' END,COUNT(*),SUM(amount) FROM Detail GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT 'stage_before_first_pay',grp,stage_name,COUNT(*),SUM(amount) FROM Detail GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_ten_at_first_pay',grp,ten_ten,COUNT(*),SUM(amount) FROM Detail GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_ten_stage_at_first_pay',grp,ten_ten_stage,COUNT(*),SUM(amount) FROM Detail GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT module "数据模块",grp "对比组",dimension "维度",users "首充人数",
       ROUND(100.0*users/SUM(users) OVER(PARTITION BY module,grp),2) "首充人数占比(%)",
       ROUND(revenue,2) "首充收入USD"
FROM Agg ORDER BY 1,2,4 DESC;
